answer: The mechanism is a slashable per-identity lock with a costly entry ticket. Before acting, each agent must post a lock that is burned, not refunded, if it is caught colluding, and must spend real compute on a one-time beacon ticket bound to that identity. An honest operator pays this once; a Sybil farm pays it per fake seat, so a thousand-seat swarm costs a thousand locks plus a thousand wasted tickets. The registry also treats a shared bridge account as one identity, so fakes cannot hide. On detection the attacker loses the whole pool, and the nectar of real reputation never accrues.
